name: Automotive Axles Ltd
title: Automotive Axles Ltd - 505010 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue up ~18.7% YoY to INR6,643m with 8% PAT, but capacity is ~90% utilised in Q4 and April-May softened to 70-80%; Phase 1/1A capex completes by Dec-26 with next phase to be decided.

triggers.label: Utilisation ~90% Q4 → 70-80% Apr-May
triggers.quote: we generally operate somewhere between 70% to 80% of the capacity

triggers.label: Next capex phase to be decided in 6-12 months
triggers.quote: that is what we are kind of working on in next like 6 to 12 months

triggers.label: Industry FY26 ~480k, FY27 seen 400+
triggers.quote: the market closing at around 480,000 vehicles it is 16% above FY '25

guidance.value: INR4,000-5,000 crores in coming years, export larger
guidance.quote: the top line should grow in the order of rough order of INR4,000 crores to INR5,000 crores
that capacity will be completed by end of December '26
we'll be almost similar range of capex spend will be there in the upcoming year as well
the next year as well, we are expecting it to be 400 plus

red_flags.label: Technical fee 4-4.5% of revenue to Meritor HVS
April-May softening vs Q4 peak
red_flags.quote: again, the market has softened a little bit

evasions.quote: it will be a little bit challenge for us to forecast what it is
While we don't want to do our forward-looking statements at this point of time
I'm not in a position to confirm there are different discussions at different levels
